title: HSK1 Gate 11 · Sui Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 11: Sui Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第11关：隋朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 隋朝的皇帝想建一条很长的河。那时候，北方和南方来往很不方便。走一次要很多天。很多人一起工作，建了大运河。
passageEn: The Sui Dynasty emperor wanted to build a very long canal. At that time, travel between north and south was very difficult. One journey took many days. Many people worked together and built the Grand Canal.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: The Sui Dynasty emperor wanted to build a very long canal.
comprehension.answer: 隋朝的皇帝想建一条很长的河。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 长 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“长”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 长 (cháng) means "long" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “长”（cháng）的意思是“long”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 时候 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“时候”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 时候 (shíhou) means "time; moment" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “时候”（shíhou）的意思是“time; moment”，就在上面的短文里。

options.text: Long ago, great floods came to China.
The floods came, and many people had no home.
The Sui Dynasty emperor wanted to build a very long canal.
